race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 3yo C&G 2nd Semi Final Pace
race.comment: THE NITESHIFT (5) is a progressive gelding who led from a similar draw before going on to win last week's heat by more than 8m. Expect him to push forward again. Big chance. SOHO TRUMP (6) has returned in fine order, winning both starts off a spell. Led to score by 1.8m last week and while he draws wider he came from deeper still in his fresh win at Menangle. Threat. NEPTUNITE (2) kicked off his campaign with three straight wins at Wagga then came from the back row to miss narrowly in last week's heat. The better draws bring him into contention. SOHO PARK AVENUE (8) has yet to miss the top-two this time in and draws for a nice trail so can be competitive along with LE CARDINAL (7) who draw wide but was tough in his fighting win last week.
